title: COMMEMORATING MR. FRANK ANTHONY: A LEGACY OF COURAGE
subtitle: Students and staff gather for the Annual Founder’s Day Assembly celebrating the visionaries who built FAPS across India.

articles.title: COMMEMORATING MR. FRANK ANTHONY: A LEGACY OF COURAGE
articles.author: By FAPS Historical Society
articles.excerpt: The campus resonated with pride and nostalgia as students paid tribute to founder Frank Anthony during the annual solemn assembly.
articles.content: Annual Founder's Day at FAPS Bengaluru was marked by patriotic music, speeches, and inter-house debates honoring the memory of Late Mr. Frank Anthony.

title: FAPS SHINES AT INTER-SCHOOL ATHLETICS MEET
subtitle: FAPS athletes secure top honors across track and field events at the Karnataka ICSE Schools Sports Meet.

articles.title: FAPS SHINES AT INTER-SCHOOL ATHLETICS MEET
articles.author: By Sports Desk
articles.excerpt: Our student athletes demonstrated outstanding endurance and spirit at the state sports tournament, bringing home 12 gold medals.
articles.content: The FAPS sports contingent displayed exceptional athleticism at the recently concluded Karnataka ICSE Inter-School Sports Tournament.
